name: AI Featured Image
description: Auto-generates a node's featured/hero image with OpenAI DALL-E on presave.
project_description: AI Featured Image automatically generates a featured/hero image for a node when it is saved without one. On node presave, for the content types you enable, it builds a prompt from the node (title/body placeholders), calls the OpenAI image-generation (DALL-E) API directly over HTTP, downloads the returned image into public://ai_images/ as a managed File entity, and assigns it to the image field you name. It is a small hook-driven helper with a single settings form (enable toggle, OpenAI API key, enabled content types, target image field machine name, prompt template) and one service, FeaturedImageGenerator. Intended for blogs, news sites and portals that want automatic imagery for content that ships without a picture. Note: it calls OpenAI directly (not through the drupal/ai provider abstraction).
